foundation_name: Evidence-Bound Vertical AI Project Understanding Foundation V1
responsibility: Understand the existing repository before proposing or creating any implementation

components.name: Repository Discovery
components.responsibility: Discover repository structure, certified baselines, and entry surfaces read-only via Repository Intelligence and Access references; never scans to mutate or invent capabilities.

components.name: Repository Inventory
components.responsibility: Inventory known modules, datasets, services, connectors, and frozen snapshots as an evidence-bound catalog; inventory is descriptive only and never creates repository assets.

components.name: Component Lookup
components.responsibility: Locate existing components that may satisfy a need by querying inventory and Repository Intelligence references; lookup must complete before any create proposal.

components.name: Reference Resolution
components.responsibility: Resolve citations and artifact refs through Access / CIL reference contracts without copying payloads or mutating frozen Platform Core, CIL, or connector baselines.

components.name: Dependency Resolution
components.responsibility: Resolve declared dependencies among inventoried components and frozen contracts so understanding describes coupling without proposing implementation.

components.name: Duplicate Detection
components.responsibility: Detect likely duplicate modules, overlapping contracts, and redundant surfaces so reuse can be preferred over new creation; detection never deletes or rewrites existing code.

components.name: Reuse Candidate Analysis
components.responsibility: Rank reuse candidates against gaps using inventory, lookup, and duplicate evidence; enforces reuse-before-create policy before any planning phase.

components.name: Understanding Report
components.responsibility: Emit a structured repository-understanding report that aggregates discovery, inventory, refs, dependencies, duplicates, and reuse candidates; conclusions require evidence.

components.name: Gap Analysis
components.responsibility: Identify remaining gaps only after reuse candidates are exhausted in analysis; gaps feed planning readiness and never authorize silent creation.

components.name: Approval Gate
components.responsibility: Require explicit human approval before any write action (planning package materialization or later implementation). Design/read understanding runs without write authority.

components.name: Understanding Evidence
components.responsibility: Bind fingerprints, refs, and precondition citations so every understanding conclusion is evidence-preceded and reproducible without mutating source baselines.
